items.name: Baton
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

This reinforced rod is commonly made from metal alloys and designed to strike and parry incoming blows.

items.name: Breaching Gun
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

This snub-nosed scattergun is commonly used to blast through doors and walls. Smaller than a reaction breacher, this scattergun is infamous for its mighty recoil.

items.name: Freebooter Armor
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.

defensiveAbilities.name: Four-Armed
defensiveAbilities.description: You have four arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can wield items only with your active hands.

defensiveAbilities.name: Raise a Shield
defensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You position your shield to protect yourself. When you have Raised a Shield, you gain its listed circumstance bonus to AC. Your shield remains raised until the start of your next turn.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shield Block
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster has its shield raised and takes damage from a physical attack.

Effect The monster snaps its shield into place to deflect a blow. The shield prevents the monster from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. The monster and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.

In addition to the normal use of Shield Block, a Free Captain gunner can use Shield Block to prevent damage from an area attack and also prevent damage that would be dealt to an adjacent ally instead of themself.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fire in the Hole!
offensiveAbilities.description: A special payload gives the breaching gun the area (15ft Type:cone) and unwieldy traits until the end of the gunner's turn. The gunner makes an attack using Area Fire (Basic DC 19 Reflex Saving Throw save) that uses 3 projectiles. Enemies in the affected area who fail their save against the attack become Suppressed until the start of the gunner's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Raid Ready
offensiveAbilities.description: The Free Captain gunner Switches Hands, then Raises a Shield or Reloads, in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shiver Your Timbers
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature damaged by the gunner's breaching gun can't reduce its frightened condition until the gunner's next turn.
